import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { cp, mkdir, mkdtemp, readFile, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { test as base, expect } from '@playwright/test';

const exec = promisify(execFile);
const project = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../', import.meta.url));
const id = '__FORGE_WEBVIEW_ID__';

/** Test the built project through the public CLI, never a sibling project's sources. */
export const test = base.extend<{}, { webview: { url: string } }>({
  webview: [async ({}, use) => {
    const distribution = dirname(resolve(process.env.FORGE_CLI ?? join(project, '__FORGE_WORKSPACE_RELATIVE__', 'bin/forge.js')));
    const workspace = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'forge-webview-e2e-'));
    const cli = async (args: string[]) => {
      const { stdout } = await exec(process.execPath, [join(workspace, 'bin/forge.js'), ...args, '--json'], { cwd: workspace, timeout: 30_000, maxBuffer: 2 * 1024 * 1024 });
      const response = JSON.parse(stdout);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Forge ${args.join(' ')}: ${response.error?.code}`);
      return response.data;
    };
    let startupAttempted = false;
    try {
      await cp(distribution, join(workspace, 'bin'), { recursive: true });
      const config = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(workspace, 'bin/config/default.json'), 'utf8'));
      config.plugins.disabled = ['claude'];
      await writeFile(join(workspace, 'bin/config.json'), JSON.stringify(config));
      await rm(join(workspace, 'bin/data/context.json'), { force: true });
      // A previously published workspace bundle must not mask this build.
      await rm(join(workspace, 'bin/webviews', id), { recursive: true, force: true });
      const fixture = join(workspace, config.paths.projects, id);
      await mkdir(join(fixture, '.forge'), { recursive: true });
      await writeFile(join(fixture, '.forge/project.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, name: id, type: 'webview' }));
      await cp(join(project, 'dist'), join(fixture, 'dist'), { recursive: true });
      await cli(['webview', 'publish', '--project', id]);
      startupAttempted = true;
      const status = await cli(['server', 'start', '--port', '0', '--webview', id]);
      if (!status.running || !status.url) throw new Error('Forge did not return a running webview URL.');
      await use({ url: status.url });
    } finally {
      if (startupAttempted) {
        try { await cli(['server', 'stop']); }
        catch (error) { throw new Error(`Server cleanup failed; workspace retained for CLI recovery: ${workspace}`, { cause: error }); }
      }
      await rm(workspace, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
  }, { scope: 'worker', timeout: 60_000 }],
});
export { expect };
